info.description: The cookie-consent banner's copy and category descriptions

edit.label: Enabled
edit.description: Turns on the cookie-consent banner for every page. Ships on by default.

edit.label: Banner title
edit.description: Heading shown at the top of the cookie banner.

edit.label: Banner description
edit.description: Explains why the site uses cookies.

edit.label: Accept all label
edit.description: Sets analytics and marketing on, saves, and dismisses the banner.

edit.label: Save preferences label
edit.description: Saves whatever the category toggles are currently set to — an all-off save is a one-click full rejection.

edit.label: Reopen trigger label
edit.description: Label on the persistent floating button shown once a visitor has made a choice.

edit.label: Necessary category
edit.description: Always shown as locked-on in the banner — never a stored toggle.
